rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF JANICE WONG
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. Although the attorney's 4/17/26 declaration addressed some issues, the petitioner's (not the attorney's) verified supplement must be filed, clearing the following issues: (1) The original will must be submitted. If this nondomiciliary decedent's will was admitted in another state (Texas), an authenticated copy of the will and an authenticated copy of the order admitting the will to probate in that court must be conventionally (not e-filing) submitted. (2) Petitioner's verified supplement stating Wanda Hand's and Wilma Reyna's relationship to the decedent. (3) If they qualify for notice, send them the Notice of Petition to Administer Estate [DE-121] under PrC sec. 8110 and Notice of Direction for Remote Appearances and Access under Local Rule 14.1.C.6). If they are step-sisters, notice may not be required unless they are named in the decedent's will, as step-siblings may not be included in Petitions #5, 6, and 7. (4) Confidential Statement of Birth Date and Driver's License Number [Form DE-147S] must be filed. Local Rule 4.18.E. (5) Proof of publication on file 3/16/2026 shows that the publication failed to set forth that the petition requests admission of the decedent's will. PrC sec. 8120. CRC 7.50. Re-publication is required. (6) Petitioner's verified supplement must be filed, clearing the following issues: a) #5.a. (3)-(4) regarding surviving registered domestic partner. b) #2.d regarding bond. A minimum bond of $20,000 is required for a non-California resident personal representative under Local Rule 14.16.E. c) In Petition #3.d, specify whether the $600,000 refers to income from real property or to an ownership interest in real property. d) In Petition 3.f.(2), indicate whether the decedent's will is self-proving. If it is not, file a Proof of Subscribing Witness. PARTIES APPEARING SHOULD CHECK IN FOR THE HEARING WITH THEIR FULL NAME. Counsel and parties may appear personally or remotely through Zoom or CourtCall. For a video appearance, go to zoom.us, click "join a meeting" and input meeting ID 160 225 4765 and password 514879. For an audio-only appearance through Zoom, call 1-669-254-5252 and key in meeting ID "160 225 4765#", then participant ID "0#", then password "514879#". (Toll rates may apply).) The Court prefers that counsel and parties appearing by video input their first and last name into the "Your Name" dialogue box. Counsel and parties may appear by audio-only telephone through CourtCall by calling 1-888-882-6878. Please review LRSF 14.1(C) for more information.

rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE HARTZOG FAMILY TRUST DTD FEBRUARY 24, 2000
rulings.Calendar Matter: Petition For Order Appointing Successor Trustee
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/15/2026. Issues necessitating continuance: 1) A petition involving a trust must state the names and last known addresses of all vested or contingent beneficiaries, including all persons in being who may or will receive income or corpus of the trust (CRC 7.902). 2) Paragraph 14 of the instant petition implies that petitioner is the executor of decedent's will. To date, no personal representative has been appointed in decedent's estate (PES-26-309584) and decedent's will has not yet been admitted to probate. 3) Paragraph 19 of the instant petition states that decedent's beneficial interest in his parents' trust passed to the Hartzog Revocable Trust dated December 30, 2016, of which petitioner is trustee. In a supplemental declaration verified by petitioner, please clarify how this transfer occurred, as there is a pending probate of decedent's will, and assets outside of decedent's living trust must pass via his pourover will. 4) Paragraph 20 indicates that there is no person entitled to notice under Probate Code Section 17203(c) because decedent's interest in the trust passed via his estate plan, but the parents' trust instrument leaves the residue of the trust to decedent, outright and free of trust, and decedent's living heirs are entitled to notice under Probate Code Section 17203(c). 5) The trust instrument waives bond for any person named in the trust instrument as successor trustee. Petitioner is not named in the trust instrument and the instant petition does not contemplate bond. In a supplemental declaration, please estimate the fair market value of the assets currently held in trust for the court to determine appropriate bond. Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 09/01/2026 to avoid additional continuance.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF BINH HUYNH
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR LETTERS OF ADMINISTRATION
rulings.Rulings: Hearing. Appearance required. The Court may inquire why this probate proceeding is necessary. The following issues must be cleared. (1) The following issues with the Petition must be resolved. Please submit either an amended petition or a verified supplement addressing all items listed below. (A) Caption does not specify the full IAEA authority requested, although section #2.c. seeks full IAEA authority. (B) #3.d. estimates value of the estate as zero. The Court may inquire further into the estimate to fix the proper amount of bond and, possibly, to assess the necessity of this proceeding. (C) #5.a.(7)-(8) to be affirmed (either item). Re: issue or no issue of a predeceased child. (D) #6.f is affirmed, even though #8 lists surviving siblings. (E) #7 to affirm as the petition alleges no spouse or issue survived the decedent. (F) #8 must include the decedent's parents' information. If they are deceased, the dates of death must be listed. Local Rule 14.18.D. (2) Notice of Petition to Administer Estate [DE-121] to all persons who are entitled. Also provide the Notice of Direction for Remote Appearances and Access (LRSF 14.1.C.6). (3) Proof of publication (4) Duties and Liabilities of Personal Representative (DE-147) must be filed. (5) Confidential Statement (DE-147S) must be filed. See LR 14.48.E. (6) Proposed order must be submitted. LR 14.7.A.1. PARTIES APPEARING SHOULD CHECK IN FOR THE HEARING WITH THEIR FULL NAME. rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF KASEY OCHS
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 9/15/26. (No earlier availability.) Issue(s) necessitating continuance: (1) Item 6f of the petition does not appear to be the first box that applies, if a half-sister survived. (2) Item 7 of the petition must be completed if no spouse or issue survived the decedent. (3) When second generation or more distant heirs are listed, the deceased ancestor through whom they take (or would have taken) shall be named and his or her date of death and relationship to the decedent shall be stated. [LRSF 14.18 C.] Who were the decedent's parents and siblings and when did they die? (4) A proposed non-resident personal representative must file a declaration setting forth in detail the anticipated liabilities of the decedent and claims against the estate for the Court to determine the amount of the bond. [LRSF 14.16 F.] Please provide courtesy copies of any papers filed to address these issues to the assigned examiner by 9/1/26. Examiner continuances are final and not subject to contest under LRSF 14.10 B.

rulings.Case Title: THE ESTATE OF JOE N. GRAY
rulings.Calendar Matter: PETITION FOR PROBATE OF WILL AND FOR LETTERS TESTAMENTARY
rulings.Rulings: Continued to 09/08/2026. Issues necessitating continuance:1) Petition is incomplete. In Item 5a, box (3) or (4) must be checked. 2) All persons named in decedent's will, whether living or deceased, must be listed in Item 8. Please supplement the petition to include Elberta Grey in Item 8. 3) In addition to all persons mentioned in the will, all heirs must be listed even if a decedent died testate (LRSF 14.18.C.1). Tobie Gray, Rafiki Gray, are listed in Item 8 as the issue of decedent's predeceased child, Stephen Christian Gray, with their address listed as unknown. Neither a nor a declaration of due diligence as to the search for their whereabouts nor a request to dispense with notice is attached to the petition. In a supplemental declaration verified by petitioner, please indicate the efforts taken to locate decedent's heirs-at-law, who are entitled to notice of the instant petition. Please address the above issues and deliver courtesy copies of all further filings to this examiner no later than 08/31/2026 to avoid additional continuance.
